note: 本关按重返剧本参考卡 50011 的设置差异布置；完整步骤见设置段落与特别规则。

children.text: 你和你的搭档们在故乡——马萨诸塞州的阿卡姆市，调查着一系列的奇怪事件。在过去几周内，发生了多起市民神秘失踪案。最近，有人在树林里发现了失踪者的尸体，尸体遭到什么东西的啃咬，大半都被吃掉了。警察和报纸都声称是野兽热的祸，不过你可不吃这套，背后肯定有什么其他的原因。你们决定一同到队长家中，讨论这些怪异的事件。

setup.title: 重返设置差异
setup.text:
遵循狂热之夜的剧本手册进行冒险设置，但以下步骤例外：
- 在找出遭遇组的卡牌时，还需要为重返聚集于此找出几个新遭遇组，如下所示：
- 将场景1a——“被困于此”从游戏中移除，用新版场景1a——“神秘通道”替换。
(继续阅读背面。)
将下列遭遇组中的所有遭遇卡找出: 聚集于此、老鼠、食尸鬼、恐惧打击、远古恶魔、寒冷刺骨.
将地点“书房”放置入场。将其他地点卡放在一边。每位调查员从书房开始游戏。
将食尸鬼祭司和丽塔·钱德勒放在一边。

specialRules.title: 神秘通道
specialRules.text: 目标 - 只有会客厅的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进。

specialRules.title: 书房
specialRules.text:
[action][action]：抽取3张卡牌。只有调查员队长可以执行此能力。
强制 - 在有敌人将要生成在不在场上的地点时：将该地点放置入场，并将该敌人生成在该地点。

specialRules.title: 会客厅
specialRules.text: 位于本地点的调查员不能进行抽取行动。

specialRules.title: 卧室
specialRules.text: 强制 - 在你调查卧室时技能检定失败后：从你的手中随机弃掉1张卡牌。

specialRules.title: 浴室
specialRules.text: 强制 - 在你调查浴室时揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[auto_fail]标记后：失去所有剩余的行动并结束你的回合。

specialRules.title: 走廊
specialRules.text: 强制 - 走廊揭示后：将放在一边的阁楼、地窖和客厅地点放置入场。

specialRules.title: 阁楼
specialRules.text: 强制 - 阁楼揭示后：将放在一边的远在房屋之上放置入场。

specialRules.title: 开阔坟场
specialRules.text: 强制 - 你揭示开阔坟场后：检定[willpower](4)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，从每位调查员的手中随机弃掉1张卡牌。

specialRules.title: 地窖
specialRules.text: 强制 - 地窖揭示后：将放在一边的远在房屋之下放置入场。

specialRules.title: 食尸鬼洞穴
specialRules.text: 强制 - 你揭示食尸鬼洞穴后：检定[agility](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出1张鼠群并将其抽取。混洗遭遇牌库。

specialRules.title: 嗜尸鬼
specialRules.text:
生成 - 卧室。
猎手。

specialRules.title: 深渊食尸鬼
specialRules.text:
生成 - 浴室。
反击。

specialRules.title: 狂信徒之印
specialRules.text: 显现 - 每位拥有3张或更少手牌数量的调查员必须受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。每位拥有4张或更多手牌数量的调查员检定[willpower](2)，检定失败的调查员从手中随机弃掉2张卡牌。

specialRules.title: 食墓鬼
specialRules.text: 强制 - 食墓鬼攻击你后：从你的手中随机弃掉1张卡牌。

specialRules.title: 乌默尔多斯的祭司
specialRules.text:
猎物 - 手牌最少。
与没有手牌的调查员交战时，乌默尔多斯的祭司不能被躲避。

specialRules.title: 地底深寒
specialRules.text: 显现 - 检定[willpower](3)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，从你的手中随机弃掉1张卡牌。每有1张卡牌不能弃掉，受到1点伤害。

children.text:
伴随着浑身疼痛，你们终于活着逃出了你的房子。客厅里的女人跟着你们走出了大门，然后重重地关上。“你们这些白痴！看看你们干的好事！”她随手拿起一把椅子，抵住了门。“我们必须赶紧离开。跟我来，我会把我知道的一切都告诉你们。那个潜伏在地底的威胁之物马上要蔓延到整个城市了，除了我们之外没人能够阻止它。”你们无暇多做争论，纷纷点头。那个女人快步走过了你，步入雨中的街道，向着河岸城走去，你们紧随其后。

• 在剧本日志中记录，房屋还在。

• 在剧本日志中记录，食尸鬼祭司还活着

• 队长获得丽塔·钱德勒，并可以加入其牌组中，该卡不计入卡牌张数限制。

• 每位调查员获得等同于胜利牌区中胜利点数总值的经验(记得将已完成调查的地点加入胜利牌区)。因为看到了不可告人的景象，每位调查员获得额外2点经验。
• 经验: （按上述说明计算）

您点了点头，那个红发女人将手中的火炬丢在地上，霎时间，你的面前变成了一片火海，为了不被大火吞噬，你用尽全力跑出前门。你从前门前的走道上看着你所有的东西被火焰吞没。“跟我来吧，”那女人叹了一口气。“我必须告诉你们有关这地底的威胁之物。现在，是时候团结起来，去阻止这一切了。”

• 在剧本日志中记录，房屋已烧毁。

• 队长获得丽塔·钱德勒，并可以加入其牌组中，该卡不计入卡牌张数限制。

• 因为看到自己的家变成了一片灰烬，队长受到1点精神创伤。

• 每位调查员获得等同于胜利牌区中胜利点数总值的经验(记得将已完成调查的地点加入胜利牌区)。因为看到了不可告人的景象，每位调查员获得额外2点经验。
• 经验: （按上述说明计算）

你拒不服从那个疯女人的指示，并且把她赶出了你的家，生怕她再把什么东西给烧了。“你们这群白痴！现在犯下的错误，以后就没有机会补偿了！”她试图警告你们。“你们根本不懂地底下的那个东西有多可怕......我们正面临着莫大的危险！”你们想到了刚才的事情，心有余悸，决定听她说完。或许这个人说的是对的，她可能知道些你们不了解的内幕......不过她好像并不太相信你们。

• 在剧本日志中记录，房屋还在。

• 因为不想让自己的生活从此被毁，队长获得额外1点经验。

• 每位调查员获得等同于胜利牌区中胜利点数总值的经验(记得将已完成调查的地点加入胜利牌区)。因为看到了不可告人的景象，每位调查员获得额外2点经验。
• 经验: （按上述说明计算）

你们跑到走廊，试图找到逃离这儿的方法，但是那个巨大而又滚烫的屏障依然挡着你们。你们现在已经被这些凶残的入侵者所包围，无处可逃。

• 在剧本日志中记录，丽塔不得不去找别的帮手。

• 在剧本日志中记录，房屋还在。

• 在剧本日志中记录，食尸鬼祭司还活着。

• 因为不想让自己的生活从此被毁，队长获得额外1点经验。

• 所有没有投降的调查员全部阵亡。如果剩余的调查员数量，不足以继续进行剧本，则剧本结束，游戏失败。否则，继续进行下一场冒险。(调查员阵亡的玩家必须选择新的调查员，详见《规则详解》第13页，来学习阵亡调查员相关规则。)

• 调查员阵亡的玩家必须选择新的调查员

• 经验: （按上述说明计算）

You and your partners have been investigating strange events taking place in your home city of Arkham, Massachusetts. Over the past few weeks, several townspeople have mysteriously gone missing. Recently, their corpses turned up in the woods, savaged and half - eaten. The police and newspapers have stated that wild animals are responsible, but you believe there is something else going on. You are gathered together at the lead investigator’s home to discuss these bizarre events.

setup.title: Return to Setup Changes
setup.text:
Perform the setup as indicated in the Night of the Zealot Campaign Guide, with the following exceptions:
- When gathering encounter sets, also gather the new encounter sets for Return to The Gathering shown here.
- Remove Act 1a- "Trapped" from the game and replace it with the new Act 1a- "Mysterious Gateway."
(Continued on reverse side.)
Gather all cards from the following encounter sets: The Gathering, Rats, Ghouls, Striking Fear, Ancient Evils, and Chilling Cold.
Put the Study location into play. Set each other location aside, out of play. Each investigator begins play in the Study.
Set the Ghoul Priest and Lita Chantler cards aside, out of play.

specialRules.title: Mysterious Gateway
specialRules.text: Objective - Only investigators in the Guest Hall may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.

specialRules.title: Study
specialRules.text:
[action] [action]: Draw 3 cards. Only the lead investigator can activate this ability.
Forced - When an enemy attempts to spawn at a location that is not in play: Put that location into play and spawn that enemy there.

specialRules.title: Guest Hall
specialRules.text: Investigators in this location cannot take draw actions.

specialRules.title: Bedroom
specialRules.text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the Bedroom: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

specialRules.title: Bathroom
specialRules.text: Forced - After you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [auto_fail] symbol while investigating the Bathroom: Lose all remaining actions and end your turn.

specialRules.title: Hallway
specialRules.text: Forced - After you reveal this location: Put the set-aside Attic, Cellar, and Parlor locations into play.

specialRules.title: Attic
specialRules.text: Forced - After you reveal the Attic: Put the set-aside Far Above Your House location into play.

specialRules.title: Field of Graves
specialRules.text: Forced - After you reveal Field of Graves: Test [willpower] (4). For each point you fail by, discard 1 card at random from each player's hand.

specialRules.title: Cellar
specialRules.text: Forced - After you reveal the Cellar: Put the set-aside Deep Below Your House location into play.

specialRules.title: Ghoul Pits
specialRules.text: Forced - After you reveal Ghoul Pits: Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Swarm of Rats and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.

specialRules.title: Corpse-Hungry Ghoul
specialRules.text:
Spawn - Bedroom.
Hunter.

specialRules.title: Ghoul from the Depths
specialRules.text:
Spawn - Bathroom.
Retaliate.

specialRules.title: The Zealot's Seal
specialRules.text: Revelation - Each investigator with 3 or fewer cards in hand must take 1 damage and 1 horror. Each investigator with 4 or more cards in hand tests [willpower] (2). Each investigator who fails must discard 2 cards at random from his or her hand.

specialRules.title: Grave-Eater
specialRules.text: Forced - After Grave-Eater attacks you: Discard 1 card at random from your hand.

specialRules.title: Acolyte of Umôrdhoth
specialRules.text:
Prey - Fewest cards in hand.
While engaged with an investigator with no cards in his or her hand, Acolyte of Umôrdhoth cannot be evaded.

specialRules.title: Chill from Below
specialRules.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must discard 1 card at random from your hand. For each card you cannot discard, take 1 damage.

children.text:
If no resolution was reached (each investigator resigned or was defeated): You barely manage to escape your house with your lives. The woman from your parlor follows you out the front door, slamming it behind her. “You fools! See what you have done?” She pushes a chair in front of the door, lodging it beneath the doorknob. “We must get out of here. Come with me, and I will tell you what I know. We are the only ones who can stop the threat that lurks beneath from being unleashed throughout the city.” You’re in no state to argue. Nodding, you follow the woman as she runs from your front porch out into the rainy street, toward Rivertown.

• In your Campaign Log, record that your house is still standing.

• In your Campaign Log, record that the Ghoul Priest is still alive.

• The lead investigator earns the Lita Chantler card and may include it in their deck. This card does not count toward that investigator’s deck size.

• Each investigator earns experience equal to the Victory X value of each card in the victory display (remember to add eligible locations to the victory display). Each investigator earns 2 bonus experience as they gain insight into the hidden world of the Mythos.
• Experience: (calculate as instructed above)

Resolution 1: You nod and allow the red-haired woman to set the walls and floor of your house ablaze. The fire spreads quickly, and you run out the front door to avoid being caught in the inferno. From the sidewalk, you watch as everything you own is consumed by the flames. “Come with me,” the woman says. “You must be told of the threat that lurks below. Alone, we are surely doomed…but together, we can stop it.”

• In your Campaign Log, record that your house has burned to the ground.

• The lead investigator earns the Lita Chantler card and may include it in their deck. This card does not count toward that investigator’s deck size.

• The lead investigator suffers 1 mental trauma from watching their home become a smoldering ruin.

• Each investigator earns experience equal to the Victory X value of each card in the victory display (remember to add eligible locations to the victory display). Each investigator earns 2 bonus experience as they gain insight into the hidden world of the Mythos.
• Experience: (calculate as instructed above)

Resolution 2: You refuse to follow the overzealous woman’s order and kick her out of your home for fear that she will set it ablaze without your permission. “Fools! You are making a grave mistake!” she warns. “You do not understand the threat that lurks below…the grave danger we are all in!” Still shaken by the night’s events, you decide to hear the woman out. Perhaps she can shed some light on these bizarre events…but she doesn’t seem to trust you very much.

• In your Campaign Log, record that your house is still standing.

• The lead investigator earns 1 experience, as they refuse to let the night’s events destroy their life.

• Each investigator earns experience equal to the Victory X value of each card in the victory display (remember to add eligible locations to the victory display). Each investigator earns 2 bonus experience as they gain insight into the hidden world of the Mythos.
• Experience: (calculate as instructed above)

Resolution 3: You run to the hallway to try to find a way to escape the house, but the burning-hot barrier still blocks your path. Trapped, the horde of feral creatures that have invaded your home close in, and you have nowhere to run.

• In your Campaign Log, record that Lita was forced to find others to help her cause.

• In your Campaign Log, record that your house is still standing.

• In your Campaign Log, record that the Ghoul Priest is still alive.

• Each investigator who has not resigned is killed. If there are not enough investigators to continue the campaign, the campaign is over and the players lose. Otherwise, advance to the next scenario. (Each player whose investigator has been killed must choose a new investigator from the pool of available investigators. Refer to page 13 of the Rules Reference for the full rules on killed investigators.)

• If the lead investigator was killed, choose an investigator to earn the Lita Chantler card. That investigator may include this card in their deck. It does not count toward that investigator’s deck size.
